access.removeHistory: The access stays in their history as removed; you can give it again later.
access.onlyPlatformBody: After this they can sign in but act on no Platform, until you give access again.
access.lastListedTitle: No other operator is listed for {{name}}.
access.lastListedBody: You can still act on it as the Company owner. This is a warning from the demo operator list, not a Nawara Core rule.
access.stepUpNext: Next: verify it’s you with your authenticator code.
access.factorHint: Nawara Core also accepts a passkey or your secret key for this change; this version of Admin asks for the code. The verification is used once, for this change only.
access.pendingNote: Sent to Nawara Core. Closing this dialog does not stop it.
access.unchecked: The Platform access could not be checked. Use Check again, or open the operator again later.
access.nowAssigned: {{name}} is now assigned to this operator, possibly by another change.
access.nowRemoved: {{name}} is no longer assigned to this operator, possibly by another change.
access.stillUnassigned: {{name}} is still not assigned. Nothing was changed; you can try again with a new verification.
access.stillAssigned: {{name}} is still assigned. Nothing was changed; you can try again with a new verification.
access.granted: {{name}} access given. It applies from the operator’s next request.
access.removed: Access to {{name}} removed. The operator’s next request on it will be refused.
access.notChanged: Platform access to {{name}} was not changed.

failure.conflict: Nawara Core says this Platform is already assigned to the operator. It was not sent again.
failure.refused: Nawara Core did not apply the change: the operator or the access was not found as expected. It was not sent again.
failure.unknown: No answer came back. Nawara Core may or may not have applied the change. It was not sent again.
failure.unavailable: The service could not check the Platform right now, so nothing was confirmed. It was not sent again.
failure.rateLimited: Too many requests right now. Try again in a moment.

account.blockEffect: Blocking stops this operator everywhere at once: sign-in, every open session and every Platform. Their Platform access is kept for when you unblock them.
account.unblockEffect: Unblocking lets them sign in again with a new working code. Sessions ended by the block stay ended.
account.waiting: Wait: an account change is being sent.
account.blockBody: This operator will be stopped everywhere, at once:
account.unblockBody: This operator will be able to sign in again:
account.blockSessions: They are signed out of every open session, and cannot sign in.
account.blockCodes: Any unused working code or confirmation code they were sent is cancelled.
account.blockPlatforms: They can act on no Platform while blocked. Their Platform assignments stay recorded.
account.blockNoMembership: No organization membership or admin role changes.
account.blockUnblockLater: Unblocking later requires a fresh sign-in: it does not bring back the sessions this ends.
account.noStepUp: Nawara Core asks no verification for this emergency control.
account.unconfirmedTitle: This operator has not confirmed their account.
account.unconfirmedBody: Blocking cancels their confirmation code. Until Nawara Core supports confirmation-code recovery (CF-16), unblocking does not provide a way to complete confirmation.
account.unblockSignIn: They sign in with a new working code: sessions ended by the block stay ended, and cancelled codes stay cancelled.
account.unblockPlatforms: Their retained Platform assignments become effective again once the account is active and they sign in successfully.
account.unblockNothingElse: Unblocking does not confirm an account, and changes nothing else.
account.unconfirmedUnblockTitle: This operator has not confirmed their account.
account.unconfirmedUnblockBody: If a block cancelled their confirmation code, they cannot confirm until Nawara Core supports confirmation-code recovery (CF-16). Admin offers no resend.
account.demoState: The account state shown is demo data: Nawara Core does not show it to Admin yet.
account.pendingNote: Sent to Nawara Core. Closing this dialog does not stop it.
account.blocked: Operator blocked. They are signed out everywhere.
account.unblocked: Operator unblocked. They can sign in again with a new working code.
account.notConfirmed: The account change was not confirmed.
account.gone: This operator is no longer one of your operators.
account.unchecked: The account could not be checked. Use Check again, or open the operator again later.
account.nowBlocked: The account now shows as blocked, possibly from your request.
account.nowActive: The account now shows as not blocked, possibly from your request.
account.stillActive: The account still shows as not blocked.
account.stillBlocked: The account still shows as blocked.
account.coreCannotReread: This is the demo state. With Nawara Core, Admin cannot re-read an operator’s account state yet, so it could not confirm either way.
account.repeatWarning: Sending it again is a separate request: the earlier one may already have applied, and Nawara Core records every request, so this can add another audit entry.
account.blockedBanner: This account is blocked: the operator cannot sign in and can act on no Platform, including those listed below.

failure.unknown: No answer came back. Nawara Core may or may not have applied the change. It was not sent again.
failure.unavailable: The service did not confirm the change, so it may not have applied. It was not sent again.
failure.refused: Nawara Core did not apply the change to this operator. It was not sent again.

account.keptHint: Recorded assignments. They grant nothing while the account is blocked, and apply again once it is unblocked and the operator signs in.

create.title: Create an operator
create.lead: Give one contact: an email address or a phone number. Nawara Core sends it a one-time code to confirm it.
create.emailHint: The operator signs in with this address. It is saved in lower case.
create.phoneHint: With the country code, for example +33 6 12 34 56 78. Spaces, brackets and dashes are removed.
create.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
create.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number: 8 to 15 digits, optionally starting with +.
create.confirmNext: They confirm their contact with the code before they can sign in.
create.noPlatform: They start with no Platform access: give it after creating them.
create.recorded: This action is recorded in the activity log.
create.simulated: Demo: operator creation is simulated; no message is sent.
create.purpose: Creating an operator with the contact
create.created: Operator created. They must confirm their contact before signing in.

failure.duplicate: This contact is already used by a Nawara account, so no operator was created. Use another email address or phone number.
failure.unknown: No answer came back. Nawara Core may or may not have created the operator. It was not sent again.
failure.unavailable: The service is unavailable. No operator was created. Try again in a moment.
failure.refused: You can’t create operators any more: your access may have changed. Nothing was created.

create.found: An operator with this contact now exists.
create.foundCaveat: This does not show whether your request created it.
create.notFound: No operator with this contact appears in the list. The outcome is still uncertain. You can try again: you will verify again.
create.unchecked: The operator list could not be checked.
create.coreCannotLookUp: Demo list only: Nawara Core cannot look an operator up by contact yet, and sending the request again could be refused as “already used” either way.
create.nextCode: Nawara Core sends a one-time confirmation code to their contact. Admin never sees it.
create.nextConfirm: They confirm their contact from the sign-in page (“Confirm your contact”), then request a working code.
create.nextAccess: Give them access to a Platform: until then they can sign in but act on nothing.
create.nextNoResend: The code expires after a while, and Nawara Core cannot send a new one yet. Blocking the account cancels it for good.
create.nextDemo: Demo: no message is sent. The operator confirms with the demo confirmation code shown on the sign-in page.

header.title: Licenses & entitlements

licenses.provisional: Provisional view: Nawara Core’s Billing service has no owner read of subscriptions yet. These figures come from demo records.

figures.label: Subscription figures

licenses.entitledNow: Entitled now: {{entitled}} of {{total}} Organizations ({{active}} active, {{grace}} in grace).

platforms.title: By Platform
platforms.caption: Organization subscriptions by Platform, and each Platform’s Personal Premium count
platforms.premiumNote: Personal Premium is a person’s own subscription in a product: a separate demo count, never added to Organization subscriptions and unrelated to memberships.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.none: No subscription is in grace or ending within {{days}} days.

meaning.title: What these states mean
meaning.active: The Organization’s one subscription has not ended. It is entitled.
meaning.grace: It ended less than {{hours}} hours ago. It stays entitled until the grace ends; it is not counted as active.
meaning.none: No subscription, or its grace has ended. It is not entitled.
meaning.membership: Membership is not paid access: members stay members whatever the entitlement says, and no figure here counts people or customers.

unavailable.title: Not available yet
unavailable.intro: Nawara Core offers no owner contract for these, so Admin shows nothing in their place:
unavailable.allocation: License or seat allocation: Core has no license entity; an Organization is entitled or not.
unavailable.changes: Creating, renewing, extending or ending a subscription.
unavailable.revenue: Revenue: payment attempts are never revenue, and settled payments are not readable.

states.emptyDescription: Your Platforms have no Organizations, so there is no subscription to show.
states.notInBuildDescription: Nawara Core’s Billing service does not offer an owner read of subscriptions yet, so there is nothing to show. No figure is estimated.
states.forbiddenDescription: Subscriptions and entitlements are shown to the Company owner only.

platform.title: Organization subscriptions
platform.subtitle: Every Organization of this Platform: its subscription, when it ends, and whether it is entitled now.
platform.caption: Each Organization’s subscription state, timeline and entitlement
platform.noMatch: No Organization matches this search and filter.
platform.independence: Memberships, Personal Premium and payment issues are separate: a payment issue never changes a subscription state here, and members stay members whatever the entitlement.
platform.emptyDescription: There is no subscription to show.
platform.notFoundDescription: This Platform does not exist or is not one of your Company’s.

header.title: Billing & payments

billing.provisional: Provisional view: Nawara Core’s Payment and Billing services have no owner read yet. These follow-ups come from demo records and carry no amount.

list.title: Payment follow-ups

meaning.title: What these issues mean

meaning.awaitingAction: A payment for this Organization awaits action by its payer. Nothing has been collected or settled.

unavailable.title: Not available yet
unavailable.intro: Nawara Core offers no owner contract for these, so Admin shows nothing in their place:
unavailable.settlement: Payment methods, provider references and settlement.
unavailable.revenue: Revenue: a payment attempt is never revenue.

states.errorTitle: Payment follow-ups could not be loaded
states.forbiddenDescription: Billing and payment information is shown to the Company owner only.

header.title: Audit log
header.subtitle: Administrative activity of your Company, its Platforms and Organizations.

simulated.title: Simulated administrative activity — not Core audit evidence.
simulated.body: These events come from this build’s demo records. They are not Nawara Core’s audit records: they are not immutable, verified or complete, carry no retention guarantee and are not delivered in real time.

filters.unknown: This Platform or Organization is not one of your Company’s.

company.title: Company-level activity
company.notInScope: Company-level activity belongs to no Platform or Organization, so it is not shown for a selection.
company.note: Operator accounts created, blocked or unblocked. Nawara Core has no owner read of these events yet.

not.title: What this is not
not.evidence: Not immutable, verified or certified audit evidence.
not.complete: Not a complete or authoritative history.
not.fields: No audit identifier, actor, outcome, origin, signature or change details.
not.core: Nawara Core’s audit can be read for one Organization at a time; a Company-wide read does not exist yet.

states.emptyDescription: There is no simulated activity to show.
states.notInBuildDescription: This build has no demo activity, and Nawara Core offers no Company-wide audit read yet. Nothing is shown.
states.forbiddenDescription: Administrative activity is shown to the Company owner only.

later.notHere: Uptime, latency, incidents and alerts belong to monitoring, which is not part of this page and is not available yet.
later.never: Admin never calls infrastructure probes from the browser and never shows hostnames, addresses or deployment details.
